At h=2/L the exact integral Taylor remainder for cos is strict whenever sin z !=0 despite the vanishing quadratic descent bound. Compactness and steps tending to zero force every orbit to a single binary equilibrium. At every non-antiphase equilibrium KD_q is similar to symmetric K^(1/2)D_q K^(1/2) and has a positive eigenvalue, hence expanding multiplier; a nontrivial real-analytic Jacobian determinant ensures preimages of null local center-stable sets are null. This global endpoint component is also known in stronger form from the prior 2026/11/1 Resultary theorem; its coverage is acknowledged, not claimed new. The genuine additional critical law uses A=I-2K/L, a simple -1 Perron center and stable transverse spectrum. Odd center graph y=au+a³w+O(a^5) has w=-(I+A)|u-perp^(-1)QK(u³)/(3L), giving a'=-a+ca³+da^5+O(a^7), c=Σu_i^4/3 and d=Σu_i³w_i-Σu_i^6/60. Thus 1/a_{n+1}²-1/a_n²=2c+(2d+3c²)/W_n+O(W_n^-2), W_n=a_n^-2, yielding W_n=2cn+b log n+H+o(1), b=(2d+3c²)/(2c) for all basin orbits outside the codimension-one strong-stable fiber. For the four-vertex path exact w verifies c=1/8,d=-(1+sqrt2)/768,b=(17-sqrt2)/96. Own independent exact symbolic calculation reproduced the nontrivial coefficient.
